mapper.sql: td.id, td.test_drive_no, td.customer_id, c.customer_name, td.opportunity_id, o.opportunity_no, td.vehicle_id, v.vin, p.name AS vehicle_name, td.owner_id, u.name AS owner_name, td.planned_start_time, td.planned_end_time, td.actual_arrive_time, td.actual_start_time, td.actual_end_time, td.safety_confirmed_at, td.safety_confirmed_by, td.check_in_by, td.customer_confirm_method, td.status, td.contact_name, td.contact_phone, td.result, td.customer_feedback, td.next_action, td.cancel_type, td.cancel_reason, td.remark, td.reschedule_count, td.version, td.create_time, td.create_by, td.update_time, td.update_by

FROM t_test_drive td LEFT JOIN t_customer c ON td.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_opportunity o ON td.opportunity_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_product_vehicle v ON td.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN t_product p ON v.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON td.owner_id = u.id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_test_drive SET status = #{targetStatus}, vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}, planned_start_time = #{plannedStartTime}, planned_end_time = #{plannedEndTime}, reschedule_count = reschedule_count + 1, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE t_test_drive SET status = #{targetStatus}, cancel_type = #{cancelType}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE t_test_drive SET status = 'CHECKED_IN', actual_arrive_time = #{arriveTime}, check_in_by = #{updateBy}, customer_confirm_method = #{customerConfirmMethod}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
